channel.title: RVA Burlesque
channel.description: Burlesque shows in Richmond, VA. Confirmed dates only; tentative [TBD] dates are kept out of the feed until firmed up.

item.title: Pours and Pasties FXBG: Burlesque and Variety Show
item.description:
When: Friday, June 5, 2026

Where: Strangeways Brewing Fredericksburg, 3009 Plank Rd, Fredericksburg, VA 22407

Pours and Pasties Burlesque & Variety Show returns to Strangeways Brewing Fredericksburg with a lineup that's equal parts fierce, funny, and unforgettable.

item.title: Orchard After Dark 6/6
item.description:
When: Saturday, June 6, 2026 · 8pm

Where: Blue Bee Cider, 4811 Bethlehem Rd, Richmond, VA

Cost: $21.00

A sultry, whimsical burlesque fantasy set in an enchanted orchard at Blue Bee Cider. Doors 7:30 PM, show 8:00 PM. 18+.

item.title: Nerdy Thirsty Thursdays
item.description:
When: Thursday, June 11, 2026 · 8pm – 11pm

Where: Gallery5, 200 West Marshall Street, Richmond, VA 23220

Bi-monthly nerdlesque night featuring pop-up burlesque performers from across the DMV, Jackbox games with prizes, trading cards, and anime merch.

item.title: Gemini Music Video Release Party!
item.description:
When: Saturday, June 13, 2026 · 7pm – 12am

Where: DreamHaus, 110 N 18th St, Richmond, VA 23223

Cost: $20

Intimate cabaret night premiering Goldii's music video "Gemini" with drag by Zorro Nova, live music from MADS, and burlesque by Empress de Naste, followed by an afterparty set by The Disco Cat. 21+ only.

item.title: Orchard After Dark 6/14
item.description:
When: Sunday, June 14, 2026 · 8pm

Where: Blue Bee Cider, 4811 Bethlehem Rd, Richmond, VA

Cost: $26.25

Second night of the Orchard After Dark burlesque fantasy series at Blue Bee Cider, featuring a different cast with an interconnected story. Doors 7:30 PM, show 8:00 PM. 18+.

item.title: QUEER ALL WEEKEND! @ GALLERY5
item.description:
When: Saturday, June 20, 2026 · 1pm – 11pm

Where: Gallery5, 200 West Marshall Street, Richmond, VA 23220

Two-day queer arts festival featuring Poppy la Fae and a roster of variety performers, with live music, a trans vision board art installation, and an end-of-night dance party.

item.title: Queer All Weekend @ Gallery5 — Burlesque & Variety Show
item.description:
When: Saturday, June 20, 2026 · 7pm – 10pm

Where: Gallery5, 200 West Marshall Street, Richmond, VA 23220

Part of the 4th Annual Gay All Day! Fest and inaugural Trans All Night! event, featuring a full day of queer community programming. The evening Burlesque & Variety Show (7–10 PM) is described as 'not for the kiddos.'

item.title: Pours and Pasties: Burlesque and Variety Show
item.description:

Where: Strangeways Brewing - Scott's Addition, 3202 W Leigh St, Richmond, VA 23230

Pours and Pasties is back at Strangeways Brewing in Scott's Addition for a wild night of glitter, giggles, and tantalizing talent.
